name: room-probes-ab
description: R7-L pixel attribution. ONE boot, ONE variable: the `roomProbeMix` uniform flipped 1 -> 0 on every patched material. Everything else is held identical — boot order, async load state, GPU warm state, the lightmap hit rate — which a two-boot A/B structurally cannot do: two boots of the SAME build measured 552/1320 vs 480/1224 lightmap key lookups on their own, so a two-boot difference is not attributable. The difference between these two sets IS the feature's contribution and nothing else. Cost is measured through `__three.advance` (the real composer-inclusive driver), not `gl.render`.

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setLightsMode?.('off'); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.setDeviceClass?.('capable'); s.hideLoading?.() })()

steps.name: pin-device-class
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store; s.getState().setDeviceClass('capable'); s.setState({ setDeviceClass: () => {} }) })()

steps.name: assert-arm-on
steps.eval: (() => { const on = window.__store.getState().featureFlags.roomProbes; if (on !== true) throw new Error('arm is NOT on: roomProbes=' + on) })()

steps.name: hide-hud
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.hideLoading?.(); s.dismissCallout?.('walk-mode'); s.dismissCallout?.('walk-move'); s.dismissChecklist?.() })()

steps.name: census
steps.eval: (() => { const rooms = new Set(); let n = 0; window.__three.scene.traverse((o) => { const m = o.material; const r = m && !Array.isArray(m) && m.userData && m.userData.roomProbeRecord; if (r) { n++ } }); console.log('[probe] patched materials=' + n); if (n === 0) throw new Error('roomProbes on, but NOTHING is patched — the feature is inert') })()

steps.name: p-mix1-kitchen-counter
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(8.8, 7.4); l.setYaw(2.05); l.setPitch(-0.05) })()

steps.name: cost-mix1
steps.eval: (() => { const a = window.__three.advance; for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) a(performance.now() / 1000, true); const t0 = performance.now(); for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) a(performance.now() / 1000, true); console.log('[probe] ARM=mix1 frameMs=' + ((performance.now() - t0) / 40).toFixed(3) + ' programs=' + window.__three.gl.info.programs.length + ' textures=' + window.__three.gl.info.memory.textures) })()

steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(8.8, 7.4); l.setYaw(2.05); l.setPitch(-0.6) })()

steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(2.69, 5.3); l.setYaw(3.1416); l.setPitch(-0.05) })()

steps.name: p-mix1-living-window
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(10.9, 5.2); l.setYaw(0); l.setPitch(-0.05) })()

steps.name: set-mix-0
steps.eval: (() => { let n = 0; window.__three.scene.traverse((o) => { const m = o.material; const r = m && !Array.isArray(m) && m.userData && m.userData.roomProbeRecord; if (r) { r.uniforms.mix.value = 0; n++ } }); window.__three.invalidate(); console.log('[probe] mix -> 0 on ' + n + ' materials'); if (n === 0) throw new Error('nothing patched') })()
